items.text: **Grain slices on a held note: the chopped rhythm.** **Double-tap a held note** and its Grain panel opens beside it: **Slices** (Off, 4, 8 or 16 a bar), **Pattern** (Steady, Swing, Stutter, Scramble) and a **die** that rolls a new pattern. The note's own sound is cut into that many slices, locked to the tempo bar (Breath and drift too), and each held note keeps its own. Off by default.
A single tap on a held note still lets it go, now after a brief pause (about a third of a second) to see whether a second tap is coming.

**Fixed: the Field button is back** on the tempo bar, as it was. In 0.9.64 the new Air button took its place by mistake. **Air now stands where Swell was** in the lower bar (the cloud icon): tap it for the cloud pads, Cloud look and Loop grains; tap again to close. Swell is not gone: it still works on the S key.

**An Air button on the tempo bar**, where the wave (Field) button was. Tap it and the heads-up display opens on Dice and air, with the cloud controls beside the pad: **Cloud · Scatter** and **Spread · Direction** pads, **Cloud look** presets, and **Loop grains** (Off, Each held note, All held notes). Tap it again to close. The Field is still reached from the Layers on the right rail and from the Field and marks pane.

**The right rail no longer hangs below the grid on a shorter phone screen.** When the buttons were already at their smallest and still did not fit, the last one stood below the panel and nearly touched the tempo bar. The gaps between the rail's groups now tighten first, then the buttons shrink a little more.
**Credits.** The Index no longer lists the grain instrument that inspired the cloud controls; the granular-synthesis foundations (Gabor, Xenakis, Roads) stay.

**Air has five more cloud controls**, in The air after Grain: **Cloud density**, **Scatter** (how far grains stray in pitch), **Spread** (how wide in the room), **Direction** (falling to rising) and **Shape** (a burst at the start, or evenly). In the middle each plays exactly as Air always has, so your scores do not change. **Cloud look** presets: As before, Shimmer, Dust, Swarm, Rain, Rise.

**Loop grains.** Your hand loop (Loop your hand, on the right rail) can now scatter grains too. Each time the loop touches a held note, a few grains of that note's own sound fall over the time until the loop's next move. **Each held note** keeps every voice distinct; **All held notes** makes one shared cloud timed by the loop. Off by default.

**Breath, on the tempo.** In The lines, next to Tempo: the tempo swells and eases on a slow cycle (Sine, Tide or Pendulum), up to half an octave each way, with a length of 4 to 64 beats. Presets: Still, Slow tide, Pendulum, Heave. Off by default.

**Soniscale looks after the grains.** A cloud may use at most 60% of the room left under the device's ceiling, so a crowded device thins the cloud before it drops notes; a skipped or folded note makes no cloud; No limit takes everything. Test: `Modules/tests/grains.mjs`.

**Record and Share are two buttons.** The red circle now opens the **Record** sheet for the live things: video, GIF and sound (a take, stems, a seamless loop or a batch). The new **Share** button, a box with an up arrow as in Current, opens the picture and the notes. The camera icon is gone, because it suggested a camera input; that will come later, in the full-screen view.
**Loop your hand moved to the right rail, under Hold**, next to the pencil and the finger. It still records your hand moves as a loop, not a video. Hold it to clear the loop.

**Next has a notch** (swipe up on it, right-click, or the menu key; holding it still opens the Scores display): add this score to the performance, go to a score, or roll this score again without moving on.

**On air is clean.** The page you point OBS at (`?autopilot=calm`, `steady` or `lively`) no longer shows the "Performing? There is a short checklist" reminder over the picture, and it hides the scrollbar and the cursor, so the stream carries only the grid and the field.
